p, k = map(int, input().split())

parent = list(range(p))

def findParent(x):
    if parent[x] == x:
        return x
    parent[x] = findParent(parent[x])
    return parent[x]

def mergeSets(x, y):
    px = findParent(x)
    py = findParent(y)
    if px != py:
        parent[px] = py

for i in range(1, p):
    if (k * i) % p != 0:
        mergeSets((k * i) % p, i)

group_ids = set()
for i in range(1, p):
    group_ids.add(findParent(i))

group_count = p if k == 1 else len(group_ids)

total = 1
MOD = 1000000007
for _ in range(group_count):
    total = (total * p) % MOD

print(total)
